name: ChatGPT
short_desc: External: Connect your ChatGPT subscription once; your agent on this server uses it.
author: Humanity Labs
description: Connect your ChatGPT Plus or Pro subscription to your Wizard server once. The sign-in is your Hermes Agent's own ChatGPT login (a short code you approve on ChatGPT), so Hermes keeps and renews it and this app never sees it. The app shows whether ChatGPT is connected and reports that to Wizard's Resources screen; usage numbers there come from the agent's own sign-in. Needs the Hermes Agent app from Wizard Apps.

form_fields.label: Page password (optional)
form_fields.hint: Leave empty on a Tailscale-only server. If set (use 16+ characters), your browser asks for it (any username) before showing this page.

form_fields.label: Hermes Agent dashboard username
form_fields.hint: Filled in automatically from your Hermes Agent app. Used only to start ChatGPT sign-in inside the agent.

form_fields.label: Hermes Agent dashboard password
form_fields.hint: Filled in automatically from your Hermes Agent app (the same dashboard password). ChatGPT signs in inside Hermes, so this app never sees that token.

form_fields.label: Hermes Agent dashboard address (optional)
form_fields.hint: Leave empty to use the Hermes Agent app (http://hermes-agent:9119). Set it only if your agent's dashboard runs elsewhere.
